post.originalText:
With Gemini 4 Argon now in Antigravity, I pit it against 3.8 Flash head to head with Blender MCP

Asked them to make a full "Impossible Marble Machine" with moving gears, an iris mechanism, a marble track, lighting, materials and animation. The difference between these two is pretty huge. Look at the detail and overall scene quality

This took 20% of my weekly Argon limit, and its pretty obvious which one is which
